name: Elf City
source:
You are a young dark elf male living with your [landlady] (lol) and [roomate] (lol) in the upper echelons of dark elf society. Dark Elves are a matriarchal (formerly) slaver culture and they're very proud of the fact. 

Dark Elf men normally only get aroused once a year for mating, but you are different! You get aroused like any other young man! 

Several times a day!

You have a love goddess inhabiting your head and making things worse. Dark elf women are insane and possessive. What sort of adventure awaits?
